name: Logical Deskolemization
description: Removed the explicit algebraic equation (|C_i| = d_i) that models use as a direct pattern-match for bipartite coloring, replacing it with its exact logical equivalent in prose ("acts as a source for all... or acts as a sink for all"). This forces the model to deduce the mutual exclusion of endpoint states from the textual constraints rather than recognizing a known formula.
